items.title: 67255_Helen Humes oral history interview
items.q: you made that album with Benny Carter, Shelly Manne, and Andre Previn... I certainly did. That was one of the best sessions I ever had.

ctx.x: And "I Cried For You". There is one, and you tell me about this because I know this meant something to you, you made that album with Benny Carter, Shelly Manne, and Andre Previn, for Contemporary. And you enjoyed that, didn't you?
I certainly did. That was one of the best sessions I ever had.
